Modify the case of the first letter in each word of a character string

Source: R/utils.R
first_letter_case.Rd

These functions take a character string as input and return a new character string with the first letter of each word modified to either uppercase or lowercase.

Usage

capitalize_str(character_string)

lowercase_str(character_string)

Arguments

character_string

A character vector containing the strings to be modified.

Value

A character vector with the first letter of each word modified to either uppercase or lowercase.

Examples

capitalize_str("hello world") # Returns "Hello World"
#> [1] "Hello world"
capitalize_str(c("hello", "world")) # Returns c("Hello", "World")
#> [1] "Hello" "World"
lowercase_str("Hello World") # Returns "hello world"
#> [1] "hello World"
lowercase_str(c("Hello", "World")) # Returns c("hello", "world")
#> [1] "hello" "world"
